decisive_spans.text: Pleural fluid analysis: protein 3.5 g/dL; LDH 1413 U/L; glucose 98 mg/dL; ADA 31.4 U/L; total cell count 100/mm3 (10% neutrophils, 90% lymphocytes); amylase 11,871 U/L

response.rationale: The pleural fluid analysis with very high amylase (11,871 U/L) strongly contradicts Empyema, as empyema is characterized by pus in the pleural space, not high amylase. The high amylase in the pleural fluid points towards a pancreatic origin of the effusion, which is not consistent with Empyema. The other candidates are not as strongly contradicted by this finding.
